subject: Food Science
title: Allergens as Hazards
description: A quick win: understand Allergens as Hazards.

hook.text: A trace of peanut invisible to the eye can kill someone with a severe allergy within minutes. Allergens are lethal hazards.

buildup.text: The 'Big Nine' allergens cause 90% of reactions: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy, and sesame.

discovery.text: Cross-contact happens when allergen residue transfers via shared equipment. Cleaning between products is critical.

twist.text: 'May contain' labels are voluntary in the US—not required by FDA. Allergic consumers face uncertain risk every purchase.

climax.text: Undeclared allergens are the #1 cause of food recalls in the US—more than bacteria, chemicals, or foreign objects.

punchline.text: Undeclared allergens cause more recalls than any other hazard. Labels save lives.
